Overview

Madurai is a city in Tamil Nadu with a population of 1,500,000. One of the oldest continuously inhabited cities in the world, known for the magnificent Meenakshi Amman Temple and Tamil culture. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 290 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
